structured.answer: The cheapest S&P 500 keren hishtalmut on this list is כלל, at 0.48% "מהחיסכון" and nothing from deposits. I'd still check with כלל or my son before signing, because this is a personal site I don't know.

stuck.why: I had to read "מהיקר לזול" twice to understand that the cheapest is at the bottom, on the next screen
It shows "עוד לא דווח" instead of a fee, and I wasn't sure whether it might be cheaper
Only אלטשולר שחם and אנליסט say S&P 500 in the row. I had to trust that the lit button means all the rows follow it

findings.what: Black background with grey small text that is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Whole page, especially the lines under company names and the notes at the bottom

findings.what: It's a personal site, not a bank or anything official, so I'm not sure I can trust it
The cheapest is at the bottom, on the second screen, because the list goes from expensive to cheap
Fees are very close (0.48 / 0.49 / 0.5), so it's easy to misread
Most rows don't say S&P 500 in the track name
